lines.text: The outline remembers what the total cannot. Keep one arrangement; find another that gives the same number.
Read a term, then ask which operation receives it.
A term can be held before its quantity has been measured.
What would count as an outcome here?
A weight belongs to a relation. What is it weighting?
A separate rail offers another example; it does not drive the four-control console.
This rail lets you go below zero. The console does not.
The same symbols return. What would make their quantities accountable?
The bits stay. Your mistakes change sides. What changes when you change the guess?
Six points meet a set of targets. Whose arrangement are you completing?
Four corners can enclose a volume. A target gives your movement a destination.
A seed makes an arrangement repeatable. What would make it expected?
The branch stops. Its neighbours continue. Who can ask for another kind of ending?
Which differences enter the count?
An offered space has a boundary. What lies beyond its offer?
The light has moved. Has the invitation?
One rule, many outcomes. Which parameter are you following?
The movement came first. Then someone called it an embrace.
At zero, I keep moving.
Two fields begin together. One takes smaller steps.

pearls.edge: the reunion is furnished from outside itself: every creature here was befriended in another chamber, and a mode fired alone lights its term on the screen and moves nothing — coherence is all the calibrator can read

edge_src.quote: A learner who has not befriended the kaleidocycle would find it absent from this chamber.

lines.text: The handle moves. Where does its value go?
A signed weight arrives in another body.
Cut the route. Something still remains.
queer morphology is not a fixed form but a process of becoming
lines.note: the form that refuses to be one thing needs the vitrine to read as a specimen at all: jar sealed, lid seated, pedestal under it, shipped at quarter scale — becoming is legible here only as something collected

note_src.quote: the jar is the claim the artifact exists to argue against

lines.text: Grabbable sphere representing φ (phi) - the rate sensitivity
